author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Sometimes reality seeps
Into peripheral vision
A
Sense of mission when
Wishing brings no
Answers. Just unasked
Questions seeking
Anchors
Impossible realities, barnacles
Growing on rusted prints
Dripping in stolen yesteryear
#smallpoems
